# Bug Management Application - Project Setup Instructions

## Project Overview

- **Frontend**: React (JavaScript)
- **Backend**: Django (Python)
- **Purpose**: Bug management system similar to Jira

## Setup Checklist

- [x] Created project folder structure
- [ ] Backend Django setup
- [ ] Frontend React setup
- [ ] Database configuration
- [ ] API endpoints documentation
- [ ] Testing setup
- [ ] Deployment configuration

## Next Steps

1. **Backend Setup** - Initialize Django project and apps
2. **Frontend Setup** - Initialize React application
3. **Database** - Configure SQLite/PostgreSQL
4. **API Documentation** - Set up Django REST Framework
5. **Testing** - Configure test suite for both frontend and backend

For detailed instructions, see [README.md](../README.md)
